During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], the [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]] was first used to destroy a [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] when the Rebels '''attacked'' the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigate]] [[Shrike (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Shrike'']].

==The battle==
The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] entered the system to engage the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigate]] [[Shrike (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Shrike'']] and the frigate deployed its fighters. [[Red Squadron]] led the attack against the Imperial frigate, while [[Gold Squadron]] provided escort. The Rebels believed that the Imperial frigate would try to leave the area by racing towards a [[Navigation buoy/Legends|Nav Buoy]] protected by a small minefield.

A short time later, a detachment from the local Imperial forces arrived to assist the frigate. The detachment consisted of [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]] and [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|assault gunboats]] but it was not enough to defeat the Rebels.
